cue: Wave one hand side to side (Hello / Hi)
description: The robot raises its arm to a high, visible position with the gripper pointing upward to mimic a human hand. It then performs several quick side-to-side oscillations using the wrist to create a friendly waving motion before returning to a neutral stance.

cue: Raise one hand briefly (Greeting / Acknowledgement)
description: The robot arm lifts from a neutral resting position to an elevated height with the gripper pointing up, pauses briefly for acknowledgement, and then returns to a lowered state.

cue: Bow slightly from the waist (Respect / Greeting)
description: The robot arm starts in a neutral upright position, leans forward and downward from the shoulder to simulate a waist bow, pauses to show respect, and then smoothly returns to its original posture.

cue: Extend one hand vertically forward as if offering a handshake (Asking for handshake)
description: The robot arm prepares by orienting the gripper vertically, then extends forward in a smooth path towards the user, holding the position to signal an invitation for a handshake.

cue: Move one hand up and down vertically as if shaking someone’s hand (Imitating handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the gripper in a vertical orientation, then performs a series of rhythmic up-and-down movements to simulate a handshake.

cue: Wrap both arms around yourself (Hug / Comfort)
description: The robot simulates a self-comforting hug by extending its arm wide and then pulling it across its torso, pointing the gripper back toward itself and performing a gentle squeezing motion.

cue: Bring fingertips to lips and blow outward (Blow a kiss)
description: The robot brings its gripper close to its 'mouth' area with the fingertips pointing inward, pauses to simulate a kiss, and then sweeps the arm outward and upward in a graceful arc while rotating the wrist to 'release' the gesture.

cue: Form a big heart shape above head (Love)
description: The robot arm reaches above its head and traces the outline of a large heart. It starts at the top center, curves outward to form the left lobe, meets at a sharp point at the bottom, and then traces the right lobe back to the start to express affection.

cue: Place one hand over chest (Sincerity / Gratitude)
description: The robot moves its arm toward its own torso, orienting the gripper horizontally to mimic a palm-inward gesture against the chest. It then performs a slight settling movement to convey deep sincerity or gratitude before holding the position.

cue: Raise both fists upward (Victory / Excitement)
description: The robot quickly thrusts its arm upward with the gripper pointing up to simulate a victory pump, followed by rapid celebratory shakes and a triumphant hold at the peak.

cue: Pump one fist downward (Success / Yes!)
description: The robot raises its arm with a closed gripper pointing upward, then executes two sharp, powerful downward pulls to signal celebration and victory.

cue: Flex one arm to show bicep (Strength)
description: The robot moves its arm out to the side and sharply contracts its elbow into a classic 'flex' position, followed by a brief high-frequency vibration to simulate muscular tension and strength.

cue: Nod head up and down (Yes)
description: The robot positions its gripper forward to represent a head and performs a repetitive vertical tilting motion at the wrist to simulate a 'yes' or nodding gesture.

cue: Shake head side to side (No)
description: The robot positions its arm at a medium-high level to represent a head and performs a rapid side-to-side rotation of the wrist to signal 'no' or disagreement.

cue: Shrug shoulders with palms up (I don’t know)
description: The robot expresses uncertainty by lifting its shoulder and elbow in a quick upward motion while keeping the gripper in a horizontal palms-up orientation. It holds the peak of the shrug briefly to emphasize the gesture before relaxing.

cue: Scratch head lightly (Confusion)
description: The robot moves its gripper to the side of its head and performs a rapid, small-scale repetitive movement with the wrist to simulate scratching, followed by a slight head-tilt-like wrist adjustment to express uncertainty.

cue: Tilt head slightly (Curiosity)
description: The robot arm positions the end-effector at eye-level, facing forward as if focusing on an object. It then performs a slow, inquisitive tilt of the wrist to the side, maintaining the pose to suggest curiosity, before returning to a neutral state.

cue: Place palm over face (Facepalm / Frustration)
description: The robot brings its gripper up to its 'face' in a quick, sharp motion to signal frustration. It holds the pose briefly while performing a small shudder, then slowly lets the arm drop in a defeated manner.

cue: Point to chest with index finger (Me)
description: The robot arm positions the gripper to point back toward its own torso at chest height, then moves inward to emphasize self-reference before holding the position.

cue: Point forward with index finger (You)
description: The robot arm extends forward from a neutral position, using a sharp wrist pitch to gesture directly at the user or an object to indicate 'you' or 'that one'.

cue: Turn palm downward and curl fingers inward repeatedly (Come here / Beckon)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the palm facing down (horizontal orientation), then uses a repetitive wrist and elbow flexion to create a beckoning motion, signaling for someone to approach.

cue: Extend palm forward flat (Stop)
description: The robot quickly raises its arm to chest height, orienting the gripper vertically with the palm facing forward and the tips pointing up to create a clear 'stop' gesture.

cue: Raise index finger upright (One moment / Important point)
description: The robot positions its gripper to point straight up and lifts the arm in a deliberate vertical motion, followed by a slight wrist pulse to signal for attention or to indicate a pause.

cue: Place index finger on lips (Shh / Be quiet)
description: The robot raises its hand to face level, orienting the gripper vertically to mimic an index finger, and brings it close to its center to signal for silence.

cue: Pat stomach lightly (Hungry / Full)
description: The robot moves its hand toward its midsection with the gripper pointing toward its body, then performs a rhythmic patting motion to signify being full or hungry.

cue: Rub both upper arms (Cold)
description: The robot signals it is cold by bringing its arm across its torso and performing a rapid, repetitive rubbing motion against its upper arm, followed by a brief tensing movement to simulate a shiver.

cue: Fan face with one hand (Hot)
description: The robot raises its hand to the side of its face and performs a rapid fanning motion with the wrist to indicate that it is feeling hot.

cue: Open mouth wide and cover it (Sleepy / Yawn)
description: The robot simulates a yawn by tilting its wrist back (representing the head tilting back) and then quickly bringing the arm up and inward to cover the 'face' area with a horizontal gripper, followed by a slight weary trembling and a slow, tired descent.

cue: Rub one eye (Tired)
description: The robot arm raises its gripper to the side of its head at eye level, then performs a repetitive side-to-side scrubbing motion with the wrist to simulate rubbing an eye due to fatigue.

cue: Bow deeply while hands at sides (Apology)
description: The robot demonstrates a formal apology by first standing at attention with its arm at its side and gripper pointing down, then performing a deep, slow forward lean, holding the lowered position to show sincerity before slowly rising.

cue: Raise both hands and flex index and middle fingers twice (Air quotes)
description: The robot raises its arm to shoulder height with the gripper pointing upward and performs two quick downward snapping motions of the wrist to mimic the 'air quotes' gesture, then returns to a neutral position.

cue: Tap temple with index finger (Think / Smart)
description: The robot arm raises to the side of the head with the gripper pointing inward toward the temple. It then executes a series of quick, rhythmic wrist-driven taps to signify intelligence, a clever idea, or the act of thinking.

cue: Rotate index finger near temple (Crazy)
description: The robot raises its gripper to the side of its head at temple height and performs rapid circular motions with the wrist to signify the 'crazy' or 'loony' gesture.

cue: Slide index finger across lips like zipping (Secret / Won’t tell)
description: The robot positions its gripper tip near the side of its face at mouth level, oriented vertically to mimic an index finger. It then performs a swift horizontal sliding motion across the mouth area and finishes with a sharp wrist rotation to simulate locking the zipper shut.

cue: Cross arms over chest (Defensive)
description: The robot moves its arm from an outer position to a tight, crossed posture across the midline of its chest, holding the stance to signal a defensive or closed-off attitude.

cue: Place both hands on hips (Confidence / Annoyed)
description: The robot moves its arm out to the side and down to the waist level, planting the gripper firmly with the elbow flared outward to project a confident or annoyed stance.

cue: Lean forward slightly with palms open (Interest)
description: The robot arm extends forward toward the user, lowering its height slightly while keeping the gripper horizontal to mimic an open-palmed, engaged posture that signals curiosity and active listening.

cue: Step back slightly with both palms raised outward (Shock / Surprise)
description: The robot reacts to a sudden stimulus by quickly retracting its arm toward its base while raising the gripper with the tip pointing up, simulating a startled human pulling back with hands in a defensive 'stop' position.

cue: Cover mouth with palm (Gasp / Oops)
description: The robot quickly brings its gripper to its mouth area in a sharp, sudden motion to express shock, surprise, or the realization of a mistake, followed by a brief, anxious tremble and a slow retreat.

cue: Press palms together and bow slightly (Thank you / Respect)
description: The robot arm brings its gripper to a centered vertical position to simulate palms pressed together in a prayer-like gesture, then performs a slow, deliberate forward tilt of the arm to signify a respectful bow before returning to a neutral resting stance.

cue: Raise one hand as if holding an invisible glass (Cheers)
description: The robot mimics a toast by raising its arm with the gripper oriented vertically as if holding a glass. It lifts the 'glass' to eye level, performs a slight forward tilt to acknowledge others, and holds the celebratory position.

cue: Raise one palm upward as if inviting a high five (Asking for high five)
description: The robot raises its arm to chest height and positions the gripper vertically, facing forward, to invite a high five interaction, holding the position to signal waiting.

cue: Swing one raised palm downward as if high-fiving air (Imitating high five)
description: The robot mimics a high-five by raising its arm high with the gripper positioned vertically to represent an open palm, followed by a forceful downward swing and a slight recoil to emphasize the simulated impact.

cue: Extend one fist forward (Asking for fist bump)
description: The robot arm moves from a resting position to an extended forward pose with a vertical gripper orientation, followed by a small rhythmic nudge to signal an invitation for a fist bump.

cue: Tap one fist lightly against your other palm (Imitating fist bump)
description: The robot arm positions its gripper in a vertical orientation to resemble a closed fist. It then performs a series of sharp, short-range forward pulses to simulate tapping against an imaginary palm, indicating a gesture of agreement, solidarity, or readiness.

cue: Pat your own back (Encouragement)
description: The robot arm reaches back toward its own shoulder or torso area, then performs a series of repetitive tapping motions with the gripper to simulate a self-congratulatory pat on the back.

cue: Draw a circle in the air with index finger (Repeat / Around)
description: The robot arm points forward and uses the wrist to trace multiple continuous circles in a vertical plane, signaling 'repeat', 'go around', or 'continue'.

cue: Slice flat hand horizontally across throat (Cut / Stop it)
description: The robot raises its arm to neck height with the gripper oriented horizontally to mimic a flat hand, then performs a sharp, high-speed lateral slicing motion across the throat to signal an immediate stop or 'cut'.

cue: Swipe back of fingers outward from under chin (Dismissive / Whatever)
description: The robot moves its gripper to a position directly beneath its chin with the fingers pointing toward the neck, then performs a sharp, repetitive outward flicking motion using the wrist and elbow to convey a dismissive 'whatever' or 'get lost' gesture.

cue: Drum fingers on table or in air (Waiting / Bored)
description: The robot positions its gripper face-down at a medium-low height and executes a series of rapid, rhythmic wrist-pitch oscillations to simulate drumming fingers on a surface, conveying impatience or boredom.

cue: Turn palm upward and curl fingers inward (Give me)
description: The robot extends its arm toward the user with the palm facing up and performs a repetitive curling motion of the wrist to signal a request for an item.

cue: Extend open palm upward steadily (Offering)
description: The robot moves its arm from a retracted position near the body to an extended forward and slightly raised position, with the gripper held horizontally to mimic the gesture of offering or presenting an item.

cue: Raise both hands beside head (I give up / Surrender)
description: The robot quickly raises its arm to a high, lateral position with the gripper pointing upward and 'palms' forward, mimicking a surrender gesture. A slight wrist tremor is added to emphasize the submissive intent.

cue: Cover both ears (Too loud / Don’t want to hear)
description: The robot quickly raises its arm to the side of its head, bringing the gripper into a vertical orientation to 'cover' the ear, followed by a repetitive pressing motion to emphasize the discomfort or refusal to listen.

cue: Open both arms wide outward (Welcome)
description: The robot initiates a welcoming gesture by starting from a centered, forward-facing position and sweeping its arm outward in a broad, inclusive arc, finally holding the wide posture to signal openness.

cue: Stretch both arms upward (Relief / Stretch)
description: The robot simulates a deep relief stretch by raising its arm vertically to a high position with the gripper pointing up, holding the extension with a slight extra reaching motion, and then relaxing into a comfortable mid-high posture.

cue: Bring one hand to forehead in salute position (Salute)
description: The robot quickly raises its arm to the temple, bringing the gripper into a horizontal position near the forehead for a crisp, formal salute, holds the pose briefly, and then snaps the arm back down to a resting position.

cue: Place one hand above eyebrows as visor and look far (Searching distance)
description: The robot positions its gripper horizontally at forehead height to simulate a visor. It then performs a slow, panoramic side-to-side scanning motion with the arm to simulate searching the distant horizon.
